description: Use this when a webhook signing secret should change without breaking receivers that still check the old secret. Requires auth. Inputs: webhook_id (required). Mints a new secret (whsec_…), stores it as the current secret, and keeps the previous secret valid for 24 hours. Returns the webhook with the new secret in full once, previous_secret_expires_at (ISO-8601), and previous_secret_active true. The previous secret value is not returned. For those 24 hours each delivery sends x-cooper-signature as sha256=<hex>,sha256=<hex> and x-cooper-signature-v2 as v1=<hex>,v1=<hex>, current secret first. Verify by splitting on the comma and accepting the delivery when any segment matches. Rotating again replaces the previous secret and resets the 24 hour window. A hook with no secret just stores the new one. Needs webhook_write, the same permission as updating a webhook. Fails with 404 webhook_not_found or 403 permission_denied.

webhook_id.description: Webhook id (wh_…) whose signing secret should rotate

name: cooper_rotate_webhook_secret

outputSchema.description: The webhook with the new secret in full once.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

disabled_at.description: ISO-8601 time Cooper disabled the hook, or null.

disabled_reason.description: Why the hook was disabled, or null.

enabled.description: True when the object is active.

headers.description: Extra delivery headers. Values are redacted.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

inbox_ids.description: Inbox ids this object is limited to. Empty means every inbox on the account.

previous_secret_active.description: True while deliveries are also signed with the previous secret.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the previous secret stops signing, or null.

secret.description: Signing secret. Shown in full once on create or rotate, redacted otherwise.

title: Rotate a webhook secret
